key_findings: CBS v0.3 crawler had zero program records, while v0.4 exposed genuine official CBS programme pages missing from LLM v0.1.
LLM v0.2 preserves v0.1 high-confidence bachelor, master, and MBA requirements while adding official-confirmed programme coverage.
NXT GEN Programmes, navigation-derived campus snippets, generic deadlines, and unqualified shared aptitude/work-experience snippets were classified as crawler/template noise and not imported.
Global Finance winter/summer URL variants are modeled as one programme with two intake windows rather than duplicate records.
known_gaps: Full CBS undergraduate German/dual catalogue remains outside this focused v0.2 gap-repair pass.
Business Psychology and Business Technology are official pages but remain human-review records because catalogue granularity or page wording is not fully stable from public text.
MBA-specific English test thresholds were not found in the reviewed public MBA pages, so MBA language_requirements remain empty.
